description: Bring installed labsUI items to this labsUI version. Unedited files are replaced; edited ones are merged three ways from the version that installed them, with conflict markers where both sides changed the same lines. Returns each changed item as replaced, merged, conflicts (with the files to resolve) or kept with the reason. Run diff first to see local edits; dryRun previews. Only for installed items: new ones go through add.

dryRun.description: Report what would change, write nothing.

names.description: Installed item names, e.g. button. Empty: all installed items.

name: update
title: Update labsUI items
